verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own autonomous background automations: four AI agents for auto-coding, fraud prevention, approval routing and payment that work 'around the clock', plus auto top-up toward a target balance, automatic hotel rebooking and automatic categorization. It also offers long-running agent credentials 'for background agents that run on a schedule' and a CLI aimed at scripted or scheduled workflows. However, the recurring schedule and trigger logic for custom automations runs on the user's own agent infrastructure; Ramp ships no native scheduler, and its built-in agents stop short of moving money without human confirmation. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/workflow builder with recurring schedules, fully autonomous execution without human confirmation for money movement, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
